rules.rule_summary: Types NM and NMC cable: ampacity per 310.14, not more than that of a 60 °C (140 °F) rated conductor; the 90 °C (194 °F) rating may be used for ampacity adjustment and correction if the final ampacity does not exceed the 60 °C value; in cable trays per 392.80(A). More than two NM cables with two or more current-carrying conductors through one opening in wood framing sealed with thermal insulation, caulk or sealing foam, or in contact with thermal insulation, without spacing: adjust per Table 310.15(C)(1), and the 310.14(A)(2) Exception does not apply.
quote_segments: The ampacity of Types NM and NMC cable shall be determined in accordance with 310.14.
The ampacity shall not exceed that of a 60°C (140°F) rated conductor.
provided the final calculated ampacity does not exceed that of a 60°C (140°F) rated conductor.

rules.rule_summary: Neutral conductor counting for 310.15(C)(1): (1) a neutral that carries only the unbalanced current from other conductors of the same circuit is not required to be counted; (2) in a 3-wire circuit of two phase conductors and the neutral of a 4-wire, 3-phase wye system, the neutral carries about the same current as the line-to-neutral loads and is counted; (3) on a 4-wire, 3-phase wye circuit where most of the load is nonlinear, harmonic currents flow in the neutral and it is counted.
